data.description:
`rebar transition --help` advertises `[--reason=<text>]` on every transition, but on a plain close
the value is parsed, threaded through two call layers, and then discarded. A user closing a ticket
with `--reason="..."` reasonably believes the rationale was recorded. It was not.

Evidence:

- `src/rebar/_commands/txn.py:197` — `transition_core(..., close_reason: str = "", ...)`. The name
  appears three times in the file (`:154` is a different symbol, `:197` and `:199` are signatures)
  and is **never read in any body**.
- `src/rebar/_commands/transition.py:130-136` parses `--reason`; `:293-294` shows its only live use
  on a non-force path is `force_reason = (reason or "(no reason given)") if force else ""`, i.e. it
  is meaningful **only** under `--force`. `--force-close=<reason>` carries its own separate value.

## Scope: make the flag honest — do NOT add persistence

An earlier framing of this finding proposed persisting the close reason via the existing comment
mechanism. That is rejected. `txn.py:253-259` records the governing decision:

> Bug-close CLASS guard (ticket ed13): a bug closing from a non-idea status now REQUIRES a bounded
> `--class <value>` from the closed vocabulary — REPLACING the old free-text `--reason` (which was
> validated then discarded).

ed13 deliberately replaced free-text close rationale with the bounded `CLOSE_CLASSES` vocabulary,
which IS folded onto the `*->closed` STATUS edge and is single-sourced against
`common.schema.json#/$defs/close_class`. Re-introducing free text — in any form — reverses a recent,
intentional move toward machine-readable close data, and no evidence was found that the decision was
wrong. The "why this specific ticket" capability is not missing: `rebar comment <id>` already
provides it, it simply is not compulsory, and making it compulsory is what ed13 undid.

Related, already tracked elsewhere — do not duplicate: `bug_close_reason_ok` (`txn.py:154`) is dead
with a docstring falsely claiming two consumers; its deletion is covered by ticket
`723f-c5b2-d83b-43cb`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `close_reason` is removed from `transition_core`'s signature and every call site that passes it
- [ ] `--reason` is documented as applying to the force paths only, in `transition.txt` help, the
      `transition.py` usage string, and any overview/docs line that advertises it more broadly
- [ ] Passing `--reason` on a plain (non-force) close either has a documented effect or is refused —
      it must not be silently accepted and dropped
- [ ] No change to `--class` / `CLOSE_CLASSES` behaviour, and no new free-text field on any event
- [ ] `--force` and `--force-close=<reason>` behaviour is unchanged
data.title: Make transition --reason honest: drop the discarded close_reason, scope the flag to force paths
